process: president and vice president indirectly elected by National People's Congress; premier nominated by president, confirmed by National People's Congress
results: 2023: XI Jinping reelected president; National People's Congress vote - 2,952 (unanimously); HAN Zheng elected vice president with 2,952 votes; LI Qiang elected premier with 2,936 votes; 2018: XI Jinping reelected president; National People's Congress vote - 2,970 (unanimously); WANG Qishan elected vice president with 2,969 votes
cabinet: State Council appointed by National People's Congress
